tactics:
intro α p l f g hf
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => cases a with | mk x h => simp only [List.filter_cons, hf]; split <;> simp_all
intro α p l f g hf
: intro α p l f g hf <;> induction l <;> simp_all [List.filter_cons]
intro α p l f g hf <;> induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a l ih => (obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := a; simp [List.filter_cons, hf, ih]; split <;> simp_all)
